rules.text: Base junctions (square and oval) — in-line, L, T, X, end-of-run, V, Y available in 30", 42", 48", 54", 66", 78"H; wall-start junctions available in 42", 48", 54", 66", 78"H only (no 30"H).
Stacking junctions (square and oval) — in-line, L, T, X, end-of-run, V, Y, wall-start available in 12", 18", 24"H.

Statement of Line shows standard slim, stacking slim, standard cable-routing, stacking cable-routing change-of-height trims at 12"-36"H; however specifying page 418 and p80 list stacking change-of-height trims only in 12", 18", 24"H (standard: 12, 18, 24, 30, 36"H).
Base and stacking horizontal frame packages available in 18", 24", 30", 36", 42", 48", 60", 72"W.
Spanning top caps (square trim only) available in 36", 42", 48", 60", 72", 78", 84", 90", 96"W.
12"H panel top screens available 24"W (square trim only), 30", 36", 42", 48"W (square and oval).
Tackable and performance tackable acoustical panel packages (square and oval) available in 42", 48", 54", 66"H x 18", 24", 30", 36", 42", 48", 60", 72"W (all combinations).
Frameless glass screens — square trim only — 12"H in 24", 30", 36", 42", 48", 60", 72", 78", 84", 90", 96"W.
Panel buildups: order skins and horizontal frame packages separately (mix surface materials/colors on segmented panels). Panel packages include a horizontal frame package and skins for both sides.
Panel frame = vertical base junctions + base horizontal connecting bars; vertical junctions are ordered separately.
Stacking components can be used on both panel buildups and panel packages. Stacking horizontal frame package must be used with stacking junctions.

Standard change-of-height trim has either a rounded bottom edge (fits curve of oval panel top caps) or a straight edge (fits square panel top caps). Stacking change-of-height trim has a straight bottom edge to fit on top of standard change-of-height trim.
Base junctions and stacking junctions are always shared by adjacent panels; available for in-line, L, T, V, X, Y, end-of-run; wall-start junctions and off-module connectors also available.
Leveling glides adjust to install panels on uneven floors; range is 2 3/4".
Alternate powerkit harness routing can be accommodated through the junction opening; in in-line applications on uneven floors, route harness through junction opening to prevent harness exposure.

Panel buildup steps: 1) plan frames — junctions determine height, horizontal connecting bars determine width; 2) order skins for both sides of panel (exception: windows accommodate both sides); 3) specify powerkits where power is needed.
Corner junctions can be reconfigured by adding or removing a junction post — available only on junctions shipped on or after October 10, 2011.
When planning skin segments, add skin heights together and add 6" for total height (trim = 6"), e.g. 12"+12"+36" skins + 6" = 66"H.
Wood skin sets are available for 42", 48", 54", and 66" panel heights. Steel skins 12"H, 18"H, 24"H have ribbed and perforated options.
Answer has three top trim styles — thin, square, oval. Base junctions are specified with the desired style; styles cannot be mixed between adjacent panels.
Junction cap is included with junction when needed; caps available in square or oval style.
Slots in junction accept horizontal bars every 12", cable trays every 6", and powerkits every 12" vertically. Slotted channels accept worksurface supports and overhead storage at 1" increments.
Trim is included with L, T, V, and end-of-run junctions (not in-line, X, Y, wall-start). Trim standard in paint; fabric-wrapped or wood veneer optional.
Large openings route power through L, T, X, V, or Y base junctions; lay-in cable routing accommodated in base area and through opening in top of junction beneath top caps.
End-of-run base junction includes junction, vertical trim, and junction cap; end-of-run trim adds 1" to footprint.
In-line base junction includes junction and plastic top cap aligner (square or oval style); no junction cap or trim required.
L-base junction includes junction, vertical trim, junction cap, and one plastic top cap aligner.
T-base junction includes junction, vertical trim, junction cap, and two plastic top cap aligners.
X-base junction includes junction, junction cap, and three plastic top cap aligners (no vertical trim).
V-base junction includes junction, vertical trim, junction cap, and one plastic top cap aligner.
Y-base junction includes junction, junction cap, and two plastic top cap aligners (no vertical trim).
In-line top cap aligner is included with in-line junctions; select square or oval style.
Wall-start junction secures to stud in a structural wall (or drywall fasteners); vertical trim not needed; also used in off-module applications; adds no dimension to panel run.
Base junctions can accept a stacking junction of the same type only (e.g., an L-base junction accepts an L-stacking junction).
Floor anchor brackets secure junctions to the floor to prevent panel movement; intended for seismic zones and may require additional code approvals.

Junction stabilizer bracket adds rigidity to a panel run or when using a Universal sliding door; must be bolted to a concrete floor; bracket foot visible on one side of panel. Junctions manufactured before October 10, 2011 use TS7SB; on or after October 10, 2011 use TS7SBNJ.

Junction stabilizer bracket blocks power routing in the panel base and just above the base (covers powerkit slots in those two zones) and blocks powerkit harness, pass-through powerkit, or modular harness routing in the base from an adjacent panel; also blocks lay-in of cables in panel base.
Posts can be added or removed from corner junctions to change from one corner type to another.

Base junction finish: black paint (hidden). Junction cap—Square: paint or wood. Junction cap—Oval: plastic or wood. Vertical trim: paint (standard), fabric (option), wood (option only if wood junction cap is specified).

Junction tall sleeves (cover exposed metal edges in large cable routing opening) can only be used on junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011. Lay-in junction cable sleeves can be added in the field.
Carpet gripper glide caps may be added to panel glides — only on junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011.
Modular harnesses 43" or 80" are available to change the height at which power is routed or to route power from panel base to different heights.

Answer panel wood trims only available in quarter-cut finishes except maple (flat-cut only). Flat-cut specified on non-maple → trims ship coordinating quarter-cut; quarter-cut specified on maple → trims ship flat-cut.
Fabric application is standard in warp horizontal direction; warp vertical available as an option (see p717).
Stacking junctions can be used with any height base junction.
Stability Guidelines for application rules: see page 124.

Square/oval trim change-of-height is done with separate change-of-height TRIMS (not preconfigured change-of-height junctions as with thin trim). Change-of-height trim is available for base panels and stacking panels and is used in in-line and corner applications.

Standard change-of-height trim includes a change-of-height junction cap (square or oval style); in-line or corner application must be specified. Available 12", 18", 24", 30", 36"H, in slim profile or cable-routing.
Square standard change-of-height trim (slim or cable-routing) has a square bottom edge to fit square top caps and includes junction cap.

Oval standard change-of-height trim has a rounded bottom edge to fit the curve of oval top caps; includes junction cap and top cap filler. Slim trim plastic filler is not the same filler that ships with cable-routing trim (and vice versa).

Stacking change-of-height trim (slim or cable-routing) has a straight bottom edge to sit on top of standard change-of-height trim, includes plastic aligner, works with both square and oval trim styles (not thin), available 12", 18", 24"H.

Top cap from base panel is used to trim the top of the stacked panel. Top cap on lower panel must be change-of-height: specify the change-of-height top cap option on the lower panel for either square or oval trim applications.
Square trim change-of-height top caps have a notch in one or both ends; oval trim change-of-height top caps are shortened on one or both ends.
Specify change-of-height top caps at one end unless the panel is adjacent to taller panels on both sides; then specify change-of-height on both ends.
Specify the tallest height junction to connect panels of different heights (e.g., 42"H and 66"H panels share a 66"H junction), then trim with change-of-height trim.

When stacking only one panel on a base panel with square or oval trim, always use standard change-of-height trim. When stacking more than one panel, use standard change-of-height trim on the first tier; only the second tier requires stacking change-of-height trim.
36"H standard change-of-height trim is the tallest trim available; if the area to trim is taller than 36"H, use stacking change-of-height trim (on top of standard).
Change-of-height fin wall with wood top trim must be at least 24" lower than the spine wall when using an Answer or Universal overhead bin on both sides of the fin wall.
Change-of-height trim finishes: paint, fabric (option), wood veneer (option). Square junction cap: paint or wood. Oval junction cap and filler: plastic or wood. Aligner: black plastic only.
Cable-routing change-of-height trim (square and oval) allows lay-in cable routing in change-of-height applications (capacities p148).

Off-module panel connectors allow a fin wall to attach off-module to a spine wall in 1" increments; bottom channel has slots in 1" increments; channel must match width of panel and be attached between two junctions.
Wall-start junction must be ordered separately with the off-module connector and must match the height of the fin wall (42", 48", 54", 66", 78"H).
Off-module fin wall must always be the same height as, or shorter than, the spine wall. If fin wall is 12", 18", or 24" shorter, top horizontal connecting bar can be lowered to attach brackets.

When fin wall is more than 24" shorter than spine wall, an additional horizontal beam must be added to the spine wall at the fin wall height — order a stacking horizontal frame kit. Spine wall skins must be segmented with a seam matching the height of the shorter fin wall.

When stacking on the fin panel, spine wall skins must be segmented with a seam matching the height of the fin base panel. When stacking wall-start junctions off-module, the connector connects to the base wall-start junction.

Two off-module panels can be connected back to back at the same location. When connecting two fins at different heights on either side of the spine, an additional horizontal beam must be ordered and installed at the height of the shorter fin panel.

An off-module fin wall cannot connect flush to the end of a spine panel — closest point leaves a 3" tail including end-of-run trim. Cannot attach at a spine junction: 2" dead space on either side (4" total).
An off-module fin wall cannot be installed over a window located at the top of a spine panel.
Off-module installation requires field modification of the light seal on the top skin.
Bins, shelves, and worksurfaces cannot be attached off-module.
Off-module connector works with square and oval (and thin per p404) trims; top cap filler included is used only with oval trims.

Wall-start junction made before Oct 10 2011 with off-module connector made on/after Oct 10 2011: use 'old' bottom bracket, Service Parts T500938MP. Old connector (before Oct 10 2011) with wall-start made on/after Oct 10 2011: use bottom bracket included with the connector.
When using frameless glass on a spine panel with same-height off-module panel connections, the off-module cannot connect within 10" of an end-of-run or in-line junction connection.
Wiring/cabling cannot be routed internally from spine to off-module fin without cutting openings in spine skin; use internode power components to bring power from spine to workstation.
Wall-start junctions manufactured before October 2002 will not work with off-module panel connectors.

All existing base panels can accept a stacking junction. Top cap and junction cap from the base panel are used to trim the top of the stacked panel (junction cap not included with stacking junctions).
Stacking junction trim is included with L, T, V, and end-of-run stacking junctions; plastic aligner included with L, T, V, end-of-run. Stacking end-of-run trim adds 1" to footprint.
Stacking horizontal frame package (one horizontal connecting bar) must be specified separately and used with stacking junctions.
Base panel must always have two horizontal connecting bars; they must be in place before adding fork connectors into the junction.
In-line stacking junction includes junction and fork connectors only.
Fork connectors per stacking junction: two with in-line, end-of-run, L, and V; three with T and Y; four with X; one with wall-start.
Y-stacking and X-stacking junctions include junction and fork connectors (no vertical trim).

Stacking change-of-height trim is used when stacking on a change-of-height configuration; its straight bottom joins the top of standard change-of-height trim. Oval standard change-of-height trim is rounded at the bottom to fit the lower panel's top cap; square has straight bottom.
Full-height L, T, V, and end-of-run square and oval vertical trim is available through Service Parts in 30", 42", 48", 54", 66", 78" if a segmented visual on the trim is not desired.
Junction tall sleeve can be ordered for junctions manufactured on or after October 10, 2011.
Stacking junction finish black paint; vertical trim paint, vertical surface fabric (option), wood veneer (option).
Maximum height that can be stacked on a base panel is 36" (one 24"H + one 12"H, or two 18"H stacking junctions).
Maximum height an Answer panel configuration can reach is 90".
Maximum number of stacking junctions that can be added to a base panel is two.
Any height base panel can be used with stacking junctions.
Bins and shelves can hang from the first stacked tier only.
Consolidation point kit cannot be used with stacking components.

For initial installations order the appropriate top cap (change-of-height or standard) for your stacked segment while specifying the base panel; for retrofit, order a new top cap through Service Parts.

When adding stacking junctions to base panels made prior to January 2000, you must replace vertical trim on end-of-run base junction; replacement of L base junction trim and standard change-of-height trim recommended (old trim has hooks at top). Replacement trim via Service Parts.
Stacking Stability Guidelines: see page 124.
Base horizontal frame packages include horizontal connecting bars, a top cap, and a pair of base trims; they do not include vertical junctions or skins. Cable tray and base cable tray are options.

Top horizontal bar can be lowered in 12" increments to a maximum of 24" from the top position (e.g., for 12", 18", 24"H glass window or consolidation point kit at top). Bottom bar must always be in the lowest slot.
Two horizontal connecting bars must be used in each base panel. Horizontal bars determine panel width and are not dedicated to a height; any bar works with any junction height.
Base trim knockouts are 1 3/8"H x 2 5/8"W; top knockout for power, bottom for communication. Filler for unused openings: Service Parts TS7BTFSR.
Top caps come in thin, square, oval; horizontal frame packages must be specified with square or oval trim; thin, square, and oval top caps cannot be mixed between adjacent panels.
Omit top cap option is available on square trims and should be selected when adding a frameless glass screen or when spanning a single top cap across multiple panels.

Spanning top caps are available for square style trims only; can be used on any panel height; when spanning, select omit top cap on each panel and specify spanning top cap separately; top cap width must match total width of spanned panels.

Spanning top caps can only be used in an in-line condition; they cannot span over a corner junction. In-line spanning top cap lightseals must be specified separately for each in-line panel joint spanned.

Omit base trim option should be selected when using skins to the floor or open base trim. Base cable tray cannot be used if omit base trim is selected on one or both sides or if open base trim is used.

Open base trims do not accommodate power/data routing or entry in the base; can only be added on a junction manufactured on or after October 10, 2011; specified by omitting base trims and ordering open base trim kit separately; occupy bottom 3 1/4" (opening height 2 1/2").

Cable tray can be positioned every 6" vertically above the base; can accept added cable carriers (ZCC, Montage). Communication outlet knockouts accommodate modular furniture size only; outlets from outside vendor.
Paint color chosen on base trim also applies to top cap (not chosen independently); wood veneer is an option on top cap. Horizontal connecting bars black paint.
Use a cable tray to provide extra support for 60"W and 72"W full skins where people may lean against the panel.

Each stacking segment must have one horizontal connecting bar (one per stacking horizontal frame package). Exception: if a window is used with stacking junctions, no bar is needed. Each stacking junction specified separately; skins ordered separately for both sides.
When stacking a 12"H, 18"H, or 24"H window, stacking horizontal frame package is not needed. No more than two windows can be stacked on top of each other.
When double stacking junctions, at least one of the stacking junctions must be connected with a horizontal beam.
Stacking horizontal frame package is also used when an additional horizontal bar is needed in off-module application. Consolidation point kit cannot be used with stacking components.

Frameless glass kit includes glass screen, brackets, supports, and top cap with holes. Two brackets on 24"-60"W (spec page: 24"-84"W); three brackets on panels 78" and wider per p94 / 90"-96"W per p425 and p95.
Frameless glass can be used on panels with thin or square profile trim (not oval). Gap between adjacent glass screens is 1/4".
Frameless glass can be placed on top of a panel only; top beam must be in the top position of the frame. Usable on base or stacking panels.

Frameless glass screen will not fit between two change-of-height trims; change-of-height top cap option allows glass next to change-of-height trim on one side only (glass shortened; slim one end only).
Frameless glass cannot be used when a window is located in the top position of the panel.
A single frameless glass screen can span two or more panels; in-line spanning top cap lightseal must be specified for each in-line junction spanned.

Kit available without glass (omit glass) for customer's own glass: must be tempered, laminated glass must not be used, safety glass meeting ANSI Z97.1 recommended; max height 11 3/4", thickness .350-.400", max widths per chart.
Template tool T511082SR (Service Parts) for drilling support holes applies only to beams produced prior to September 2009.

Square panel top screen field-installs over painted or wood square top caps; support brackets must always be used with the included translucent screen; other screen materials cannot be used with these brackets.
Change-of-height screen option must be specified when using square top screen adjacent to change-of-height panel trim; panel screen will not fit between change-of-height on both sides.
Power and cables cannot be routed or accessed in a panel top screen.
Oval panel top screen field-installs over a painted oval panel top cap; cannot be mounted on wood top caps; available 30", 36", 42", 48"W; supports 6623 Metallic plastic.

Panel packages include two monolithic fabric skins and a horizontal frame package (top cap, base trim/covers, two horizontal bars). Junctions are ordered separately and always shared by adjacent panels.
Wood veneer top cap is an option on both square and oval; omit top cap is described as square-trim only (though oval spec page 430 also lists it).

Power can be field-installed every 12" vertically using powerkits; power/communication accessed only by cutting skin in field (templates T500940SR; skin cutout filler TS7STFSR; base knockout filler TS7BTFSR).

Panel package ordering: 1) specify package width/height with square or oval top caps; 2) order vertical junctions (in-line, L, T, V, X, Y, end-of-run) with matching trim, always separately; 3) specify powerkits as a package option or order separately. Cable trays and base cable trays are optional.
In-line base panel junctions (and stacking in-line) do not require junction cap and trim.

Base junction trim: painted standard; fabric optional (+$80); wood trim available only on junctions with wood junction caps (+$185 for ≤54"H, +$237 for ≥66"H). Fabric/wood trim options apply to trimmed junctions (L and T; V; end-of-run).
78"H fabric-covered junctions allow fabric in the vertical application only.
Stacking L/T/V/end-of-run junction fabric trim option applies to steel trim only; Customiz stain applies to wood trim versions (W suffix). Stacking X and Y have no trim/wood versions.
Junctions with utility pole: order multipurpose power infeed separately (p483). End-of-run junctions with utility pole can be used with thin trim also. Available 42"-78"H only.
30"W floor-access lay-in utility package is only available with change-of-height top cap at one end (square) / shortened top cap at one end (oval); both-ends change-of-height only on 36"-48"W.

Stacking change-of-height trim is only used on the second tier in a change-of-height configuration; change-of-height junction cap not included — use the junction cap from the standard change-of-height trim it stacks on; works with square and oval, not thin.

Change-of-height top cap: remember to specify on any panel in a change-of-height configuration; exception: the tallest panel never needs a change-of-height top cap. Both-ends change-of-height only on 36"W and wider packages. Square offers slim or cable-management notch; oval offers shortened top cap (one end / both ends).
Base trim knockout-one-side/plain and plain-both-sides options only on 24"-72"W (18"W has knockouts both sides only).
Omit standard base trim and specify separate hardwire base trim when accessing hardwire power in the base.
Stacking horizontal frame package: top cap not included (use base panel's); order vertical stacking junctions separately; not needed when stacking a window kit.
Frameless glass screens (TS712xxSFG) only for panels with square trim; specify omit top cap on the panel package/frame when adding frameless glass (kit includes square top cap with holes).
Square panel top screen supports color limited to 4799 Platinum, 7207 Black, 7225 Sand, 7230 Basalt, 7241 Arctic White; oval supports 6623 Metallic only.
18"W panels accommodate pass-through power only (powerkit option only 24"W and wider). 72"W panels accommodate fabric in horizontal application only (vertical fabric direction option on 18"-60"W).
Remember to order receptacles and face plates (p477-479) and junctions separately (p394-395).
